# ComfyUI Workflow Inspector

ComfyUI Workflow Inspector is a browser-only static tool for inspecting ComfyUI
UI workflow exports and prompt API JSON before hosting, repairing, or moving a
workflow to services such as RunningHub, Comfy Cloud, RunPod, or a private API.

Main page: <https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/>

Workflow diff:
<https://william08190.github.io/comfyui-workflow-inspector/diff.html>

GitHub: <https://github.com/william08190/comfyui-workflow-inspector>

Hosted MV Studio version:
<https://mv.786668.xyz/comfyui-workflow-inspector.html?source=github>

Private workflow setup and repair:
<https://mv.786668.xyz/comfyui-runninghub-workflow-repair.html?source=github-inspector>

Setup deposit:
<https://mv.786668.xyz/service-checkout.html?package=workflow-setup-starter&source=github-inspector>

The tool parses JSON locally in the browser and does not upload workflow files.
It reports output-like nodes, preview-only branches, duration/frame/FPS fields,
prompt-bearing nodes, seed fields, model references, and a copyable repair brief.

The workflow diff page compares two workflow JSON files locally and reports added
nodes, removed nodes, node type changes, changed fields, output node changes, and
a copyable migration brief.
